༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma la bstod pa gzhon nu rol dga'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma la bstod pa gzhon nu rol dga'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

snyan ngag gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog dga'i rang bzhin lha mo ni/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i gling na bzhugs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi yum/ / dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i gangs ri zhu ba las/ / gsar du 'khrungs ba'i lha mo ni/ /snyan dngags chu rlung dal gyis 'bab/ / dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bco lnga'i zla ba ltar mdzes shing*/ /bcu drug lo lon 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /sil khrol rgyan gyi phreng bas klubs/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad zla'i steng na padma bzhin/ /rab dkar gangs ri lhun po bzhin/ /ston ka'i sprin dkar phung po bzhin/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba'i 'od can dkar ba'i zhal/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan steng na/ /zla ba'i rgyab yol mdzad pa mo/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang po zla ba mtsho skyes kyi/ /stobs dang 'od zer mdangs 'phrog cing*/ / kun tu nyi ma lta bur mdzes/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs ri 'di ni padmo yi/ /spyan dang ldan na khyod zhal mtshungs/ /khyod sku gangs ri'i rtse mo bzhin/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang yang khyod sku dran byed cing*/ /a ā'i dbyangs yig la dmigs nas/ /hrīṃ hrīṃ bslab pas mun sel ba'i/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma dpa' mo rnal 'byor mdzes/ /de ring mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /snang dang mi snang gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sku'i 'od kyi phung po'i nang*/ /dkar ser dmar dang ljang ku ste/ /'dres dang ma 'dres 'od zer 'khrugs/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la lar sprin gyi bla re'i nang*/ /lus byed dkar la dmar gsal mthing*/ /rtse dang mchog dang zhi skur snang*/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la lar nyi 'od pad zla'i nang*/ /'od lnga'i phung po 'od 'bar zhing*/ /rnga yab pi wang gling bu sgrogs/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la 'od dang skar ma'i nang*/

/skad cig skad cig rnam sprul te/ /snang dang mi snang cho 'phrul 'gyed/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la lar 'od kyi gur khyim dang*/ /'dzum mdzes 'od zer sna tshogs ston/ /sprul dang yongs su sprul pa yi/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma lha mo skal bzang ma/ /yun ring smon pas de ring 'grub/ /slar yang mthong thos 'dri bar 'dod/ /de tshe khyod sku snang bar mdzod/ /gang zhig khyod dang khyod kyi sras/ /kun la dad pa de dag la/ /khyod thugs mkhyen rab zla ba ni/ /mchog tu dkar bas dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas skye ba thams cad du/ /dpal mo khyod kyis rjes bzung ste/ /blo gros thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /shes rab chen po nyid gyur cig skye ba padma'i nags tshal du/ /rigs gzugs yon tan sbrang rtsi can/ /grags pa'i 'dab brgya mnga' ba yis/ /rtag par bdag ni skyong bar shog khyod dang khyod kyi sras kun gyis/ /rtag tu bdag rjes 'dzin pa dang*/ /grags dang dpal chen mtha' yas kyis/ /rtag par bdag ni spyod par shog /gzhon nu rab dga'i rol dbyangs mchog /gang gis mthong thos kha thon byed/ /kun kyang dbyangs can zhal mthong zhing*/ /khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /de ltar bstod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun blo gros phun tshogs shing*/ /dbyangs can go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /'gro ba'i don kun 'byung bar shog tshul khrims pad rdzing bzang po nas/ /blo gros ngur ba sgra 'byin zhing*/ /bslab gsum gshog yangs dkar ba yis/ /blo gsal 'gro kun dga' skyid shog /'di ni sngon goms rgya mtsho'i khyon/ /dpal mos dngos grub cher stsol ba'i/ /bsam yas blo gros dang ldan pa/ /snyan dngags 'byung gnas bdag gis sbyar/ /sa skyong srid pa gsum gyi mthar/ /bde legs bkra shis byed par shog /'phags ma ngag gi dbang phyug ma la bstod pa gzhon nu rol dga'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/ mang du thos pa'i snyan dngags mkhan bsam yas pas lhun gyis grub pa'i ri rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas su sbyar ba dge'o//
// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) dbyangs can ma la bstod pa gzhon nu rol dga'i dbyangs/ -PAGE 12--PAGE 13--11-
